An application for the approval of a Conditional Use and Master Site Plan to operate an Event Center to include outdoor weddings and agricultural education with pack-animals. No current or proposed structures relating to this use. All events will be outdoor. Days and Hours of operation are Friday – Sunday 3:00pm – 10:00pm Spring to Fall, May-October maximum number of guests will be 150 plus a Bridal Party. The property is located at 13999 W Hwy 21 and contains approximately 44 acres in the Rural Preservation (RP) District; Sections: 20 & 29, Town: 3N, Range: 4E.
